story_theme_en: Lin and Mali were saving money for a school science camp. Lin saved 45,200 baht and Mali saved 23,800 baht. They wanted to know how much they had together. The science camp cost 34,200 baht. How much money would they have left after paying for the camp?
helper_tip_en: Have students line up digits in their correct columns before adding or subtracting. A column divider line helps.
think_story_en: Addition: Lin has 45,200 + Mali has 23,800 = Together 69,000 baht. Subtraction: They have 69,000 minus camp cost 34,200 = They have 34,800 baht left.

visual_blocks.title: Try It!
visual_blocks.question: A school has 52,400 students. 28,600 are boys. How many are girls?

data.question: A school has 52,400 students. 28,600 are boys. How many are girls?

explanation_steps_en: When adding or subtracting numbers up to 100,000, always line up digits in their correct columns first.
Draw a column divider line so ones line up with ones, tens with tens, and so on.
Add or subtract one column at a time from right to left: ones → tens → hundreds → thousands → ten-thousands.
When adding, if the result is greater than 9, carry the extra digit to the next column.
When subtracting, if the bottom digit is larger than the top digit, borrow from the next column.
Check your answer by doing the opposite operation: addition check with subtraction, subtraction check with addition.

worked_examples_en.question_en: Ai has 38,500 baht and receives 27,300 baht more. How much does Ai have in total?
There were 84,600 students. 42,300 left. How many students are left?

common_mistakes_en: Writing digits in the wrong columns, especially with numbers that have different numbers of digits.
Forgetting to carry when addition exceeds 9, or forgetting to borrow when the bottom digit is larger.
Confusing addition and subtraction in multi-step word problems.
hints_en: Draw a column divider line before you start: |Ten-thousands|Thousands|Hundreds|Tens|Ones|
Work from right to left. If you get more than 9, carry to the next column.
Check your answer by doing the opposite operation.

test_bank_en.q: Ai bought items for 28,750 baht and paid with a 50,000 baht note. How much change did Ai get?
A factory produced 56,300 toys in January and 48,700 toys in February. How many toys in total?
A library had 89,600 books. 37,400 books were borrowed. How many books are left?
Lin had 64,800 baht. After buying a uniform for 29,600 baht, how much does Lin have left?
A stadium has 92,500 seats. 48,300 seats are filled. How many seats are empty?
Tom saved 37,200 baht and Mai saved 45,800 baht. How much did they save together?
A market sold 68,400 kg of fruit in the morning and 25,900 kg in the afternoon. How much in total?
A train had 80,000 passengers. 35,600 got off at the first station and 28,900 got off at the second station. How many are still on the train?

explanation_en: Addition and subtraction up to 100,000 follow the same column method as smaller numbers. Always align digits by place value, work right to left, and remember to carry or borrow when needed. Check by reversing the operation.
